prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: I thought Priya couldn't eat the cake we ordered.
spokenPromptZh: 我以為 Priya 不能吃我們訂的蛋糕。

options.text: She ordered a cake for her birthday last year.
options.whyZh: 以前訂過蛋糕，不代表她能吃這次訂的這一款。

options.text: We changed the order after she told us about her allergy.
options.zh: 她告訴我們她會過敏後，我們就改了訂單。
options.whyZh: 指出原先的顧慮已納入訂單調整，正面回應說話者的疑問。

options.text: I'm picking it up at four on my way home.
options.zh: 我回家路上四點會去取蛋糕。
options.whyZh: 取貨安排沒有回應她能不能吃蛋糕的顧慮。

explanationZh: 指出原先的顧慮已納入訂單調整，正面回應說話者的疑問。

vocabulary.note: 是修改蛋糕訂單時必須考量的原因。
不是另外下單，而是修改先前的蛋糕訂單。

evidence: I thought Priya couldn't eat the cake we ordered. / We changed the order after she told us about her allergy.
